info.title: rustzor 0.1.0-preview.3: C# Razor apps in the browser on RustNetRuntime
info.description: The rustzor command for Rustzor apps (C# Razor in the browser on RustNetRuntime): rustzor new, rustzor serve with live reload, rustzor publish, rustzor add, rustzor info.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Where to create it (default: ./<name>).
serve [project]         Build, serve and rebuild on every save, reloading the browser.
Output folder (default: bin/Release/net10.0/publish).
add <package...>        Add Rustzor packages: ui, fetch, storage, data, signalr, grpc, ...
(or full ids like Rustzor.Browser.Media), at version 0.1.0-preview.3.
info [project]          Versions, packages and the size of the built site.
--title "My App"    The app's display name (app template).

options.name: --open
options.description:
Open the browser.
publish [project]       Publish the static site (Release).

options.name: --aot
options.description: Also compile hot code ahead of time to WebAssembly.
